subject: FOCUS DECISION: Fold7 physical-panel ID cache revalidation across shell lifetime
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-physical-panel-id-revalidation-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=FOCUS_SELECTED_NOT_YET_CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. Prior cover-readiness focus was withdrawn before claim after concurrent owners appeared. Fresh discovery/rescore after current board claims: (1) PHYSICAL_PANEL_ID_CACHE_REVALIDATION I5/E5/L4/V2/S3/P2/D1/B2 => 22. Current DuoShellService caches cachedCoverPhysicalDisplayId and cachedInnerPhysicalDisplayId once; resolver returns cached values immediately thereafter. Source scan finds no invalidation/reset except shell process death. Later wake/prewarm paths pass those cached values into SurfaceControl.getPhysicalDisplayToken(id) and setDisplayPowerMode. Logical IDs are correctly treated as disposable, but the physical-id cache itself has no proof/revalidation contract. Missing platform fact is whether Android 16/Samsung guarantees local physical display IDs stay valid and bound to the same panel for the entire Shizuku user-service process across display/compositor service disruption/re-enumeration. (2) PANELENGINE_PEER_ROLE_REMAP_COHERENCE I4/E4/L3/V2/S3/P2/D1/B1 => 19. (3) CROSS_DIRECTION_UNTOKENED_PHYSICAL_WAKE I5/E4/L4/V2/S3/P2/D3/B2 => 17 after overlap penalty with semantic-reclose/hinge-ingress claims. (4) SNAPSHOT_BITMAP_LIFETIME I3/E4/L3/V3/S1/P1/D0/B1 => 17. (5) ACCESSIBILITY_RUNTIME_RECONNECTION I4/E4/L3/V1/S2/P2/D1/B2 => 16. All newly claimed readiness/reassert, reversal, CI, input, visual-phase/security and ACTIVE_FUTURE workstreams receive DUPLICATION=5 and are excluded. FOCUS_DECISION_RECORD: select #1 as PLATFORM_GAP+LIFECYCLE_GAP+RECOVERY_GAP+TEST_GAP. INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY=validity/identity lifetime of cached physical panel IDs inside DuoShellService after initial resolution; excludes logical route IDs, exact cover lease CAS, route readiness/retry, process-recovery lease cleanup, presentation/native handoff, and angle/input/visual work. DOMINANT_HYPOTHESIS=if physical display IDs can be invalidated/rebound while the shell process survives, the current permanent cache can cause repeated physical wake failure or mis-targeting until shell restart. This is not yet claimed as a device defect. CHEAPEST_DECISIVE_FIRST_ACTION=research Android/AOSP physical display ID/token lifetime semantics and current Samsung-facing failure modes; then build a source-faithful resolver/revalidation model that invalidates only on demonstrated token/geometry mismatch and preserves the cold-dumpsys avoidance goal. No production Git writes.
